source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: The requester asks for an independently randomized complex photographic concept that can test keyword implementation, using the supplied image. My agent-owned choice is an adult woman pausing in a tidal observatory map room, cross-legged on a broad low timber platform and bracing a slight left lean with her near palm. The photograph should feel like a quiet nearby encounter after arranging a coastal chart; the body-platform relations and adult presence carry the moment. Default sensual 1 supports this through a relaxed open collar, natural linen drape and calm camera acknowledgement; fetish 0 and surreal 0 add no treatment, and creativity 1 keeps the randomized elements coherent. Reference use is limited to visible face and hair appearance; pose, body, wardrobe, environment, light, and story remain agent-owned open choices.
subject: An unmistakably adult woman guided by the supplied visible face and hair appearance, with a short dark bob and wispy center-parted fringe.
setting: A tidal observatory map room with a broad low timber chart platform, a sea-facing window, chart drawers and a muted wall map.
event: A paused cross-legged seated moment after arranging a coastal chart, with her open left palm visibly bracing a slight lean and her free right hand on the chart.
visual_priorities: The adult presence and quiet nearby camera acknowledgement lead the frame.
The pelvis, two crossed lower legs, knees, ankles and feet make the seated geometry legible.
The near open palm, connected arm chain and flush timber contact read as a coherent brace.
A folded coastal chart and subdued map-room background locate the paused moment.
Low winter sunlight and cool skylight separate linen, skin, timber and the supporting hand.
baseline_prompt_en: Make a complex photographic scene with a reference-guided subject, an unmistakably adult woman inhabiting an observable pose during a quiet winter pause in a tidal observatory map room. Use the supplied portrait as a visible face and hair appearance guide: short dark bob, wispy center-parted fringe, brown eyes, soft facial contours and pink lips. She has just arranged a folded coastal chart and looks toward the nearby camera with a calm, lightly parted mouth. She wears a sage linen shirt with a relaxed open collar and pushed-up sleeves, charcoal cropped wool trousers, and bare feet. She sits cross-legged on a broad low timber chart platform: her pelvis rests on its horizontal surface, both knees bend outward, her lower legs cross in front of her pelvis, and each foot tucks close beneath the opposite lower thigh while both ankles and feet remain visible. Her torso leans slightly toward her left side. Her connected left shoulder, upper arm, lightly bent elbow and forearm lead to an open left palm planted beside and slightly behind her left hip. The palm heel lies flush on the wood and all five fingers fan along the surface, visibly bracing the lean. Her right hand rests lightly on the folded chart across her right upper thigh; a plain graphite pencil lies separately on the platform. A sea-facing window, shallow chart drawers and one muted wall map establish the working room. Low winter sunlight rakes the linen, cheek and timber while cooler skylight retains detail in her left arm and hand. Photograph from knee height at a front-left three-quarter position, with a natural 50mm perspective and a full seated frame from head through both feet and the platform edge. The near palm contact, wrist, elbow, crossed shins and ankle junctions occupy clear readable space. Let the woman's paused asymmetric presence lead, with the coastal room settling into the background.
